note: A gate is green only when every flow step it lists is done (or not applicable: its `when` is false) and every evidence file it lists exists in <paths.gateEvidence> SIGNED (a line `Signed: <who> <yyyy-mm-dd>`, and no TODO or UNSIGNED). Profiles are chosen in qa.config.json gates.profiles.

gates.name: Consistency: inventory, requirements, cases, contracts and coverage agree (0 requirements without a test)
Decisions closed (0 open rows in decisions.md)
Backend layers green, 0 scaffold files (n/a when backend.adapter is none)
Browser suites and access matrix green, design contract approved
Mobile: Maestro series green N/N and device checklist signed
Reliability: browser suite repeated with no retries
Production backend aligned before the release (migrations, functions, flags)
Legal and store forms complete (privacy, data safety, age rating)
Published proof (store listing live, version matches)
